📰 IDG World Update Archive

Internal Newsletter of International Data Group — 1979 to 2018

IDG World Update is the internal newsletter of International Data Group (IDG), the world's leading technology media, events, and research company founded by Patrick J. McGovern in 1964. These issues chronicle IDG's global growth and achievements across four decades of expansion into more than 40 countries.
